input: قد تحرّکت بیت لحم من نسمة الله.
output: Bethlehem is astir with the Breeze of God.

input: نسمع ندائها تقول یا ربّ الکریم.
output: We hear her voice saying: O most generous Lord.

input: این استقرّ مجدک العظیم.
output: Where is Thy great glory established.

input: قد احیتنی نفحات وصلک بعد الّذی اذابنی هجرک لک.

input: الحمد بما کشفت السّبحات و جئت مع القوّات بجلال مبین.
output: Praised be Thou in that Thou hast raised the veils, and come with power in evident glory.
prediction: Praise be to Thee, O Thou Who hast revealed the Glorious Verses, and comest with the Hosts in manifest Majesty.

input: نادیناها عن ورآء سرادق العظمة و الکبریآء یا بیت لحم.
output: We called unto her from behind the Tabernacle of Majesty and Grandeur: O Bethlehem.
prediction: O Thou who art beyond the canopy of majesty and grandeur, O House of Flesh!

input: قد ظهر هذا النّور من المشرق و سار الی المغرب الی ان اتاک فی آخر ایّامه.
output: This Light hath risen in the orient, and traveled towards the occident, until it reached thee in the evening of its life.

input: عند ذلک ارتفع صریخها و قالت انت العلیم الخبیر.

input: انّا نشاهد کلّ شیء یشهد لنا.

output: Mount Sinai is astir with the joy of beholding Our countenance.

input: اجد عرف قمیصک.

input: کأنّک تقرّبت بالآثار.

input: و شرّفت بقدومک تلک الدّیار.

input: فباطل ما هم یظنّون.
output: Vain indeed is that which they have imagined.

input: انّ ربّک لهو الحاکم علی ما یرید.

prediction: I passed by the Tree, but it spake to me a heart-rending discourse, or I wish that I were sundered from my name and made a corpse unto thee.

input: هذا ما نزّلناه فی کتاب السّلطان لیکون ذکری لأهل الأدیان.
output: We revealed this passage in the Epistle to the Sháh that it might serve as a warning to the followers of religions.
prediction: This have We revealed in the Book of the Sovereign, that thereby it may be a reminder unto peoples of God.

input: انّ ربّک لهو العلیم الحکیم.
output: Verily, thy Lord is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
prediction: Verily, thy Lord is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: انّک لا تحزن بما فعلوا.
output: Let not the things they have perpetrated grieve thee.
prediction: Verily thou shalt not grieve for that which they have done.

input: انّهم اموات غیر احیآء.
output: Truly they are even as dead, and not living.
prediction: Verily they are dead, not living.

input: دعهم للموتی ثمّ ولّ وجهک الی محیی العالمین.
output: Leave them unto the dead, then turn thy face towards Him Who is the Life-Giver of the world.
prediction: Let them be unto the dead, then turn thy face towards Him Who quickeneth the worlds.

input: ایّاک ان یحزنک مقالات الّذین غفلوا.
output: Beware lest the sayings of the heedless sadden thee.
prediction: O Thou Who art grieved by the words of them that have been heedless!

input: ان استقم علی الأمر و بلّغ النّاس بالحکمة الکبری.
output: Be thou steadfast in the Cause, and teach the people with consummate wisdom.
prediction: There dost thou walk uprightly in the commandment, and dost convey to mankind by means of the mighty wisdom.

input: کذلک یأمرک مالک الأرض و السّمآء.
output: Thus enjoineth thee the Ruler of earth and heaven.
prediction: Thus commandeth He Who is the Lord of Earth and Heaven.

input: انّه لهو العزیز الکریم.
output: He is in truth the Almighty, the Most Generous.
prediction: Verily it is the sport of the Exalted, the Most Honored.

input: سوف یرفع الله ذکرک و یثبت من القلم الأعلی ما تکلّمت به فی حبّه.
output: Erelong will God exalt thy remembrance and will inscribe with the Pen of Glory that which thou didst utter for the sake of His love.
prediction: God shall exalt thy name, and establish through the Pen Supreme that which thou hast spoken in Thine affection for Him.

input: انّه ولیّ المحسنین.
output: He is in truth the Protector of the doers of good.
prediction: Verily, He is the Trustee of the Bountiful.

input: ذکّر من قبلی من سمّی بالمراد قل طوبی لک یا مراد بما نبذت مرادک و اخذت مراد العالمین.
output: Give My remembrance to the one named Murád and say: Blessed art thou, O Murád, inasmuch as thou didst cast away the promptings of thine own desire and hast followed Him Who is the Desire of all mankind.
prediction: Remember thou, O thou who art named by the Desired One, verily blissful shalt thou be, O Merad, for thou hast renounced the Merad of this world and hast embraced the Merad of all worlds.

input: قل طوبی لراقد انتبه من نسماتی.
output: Say: Blessed the slumberer who is awakened by My Breeze.
prediction: Say: O thou who art asleep, awake from the breathings which come unto thee.

input: طوبی لمیّت حیّ من نفحاتی.
output: Blessed the lifeless one who is quickened through My reviving breaths.
prediction: Blest be the life that dieth to thy breathings.

input: طوبی لعین قرّت بجمالی.
output: Blessed the eye that is solaced by gazing at My beauty.
prediction: Blest be the gaze that beholdeth The Beauty.

input: طوبی لقاصد قصد خبآء عظمتی و کبریائی.
output: Blessed the wayfarer who directeth his steps towards the Tabernacle of My glory and majesty.
prediction: Blest be he whose purpose is the purpose of an exalted and sublime majesty.

input: طوبی لخائف هرب الی ظلّ قبابی.
output: Blessed the distressed one who seeketh refuge beneath the shadow of My canopy.
prediction: Blest be he who fleeth unto the shade of those domes.

input: طوبی لعطشان سرع الی سلسبیل عنایتی.
output: Blessed the sore athirst who hasteneth to the soft-flowing waters of My loving-kindness.
prediction: Blest be they who hasten unto the Stream of Divine Grace.

input: طوبی لجائع هرع عن الهوی لهوائی و حضر علی المائدة الّتی نزّلتها من سمآء فضلی لأصفیائی.
output: Blessed the insatiate soul who casteth away his selfish desires for love of Me and taketh his place at the banquet table which I have sent down from the heaven of divine bounty for My chosen ones.
prediction: Blessed be they who are healed of their passions by the breath of the Spirit, and are present at the table which Thou hast spread from the heaven of Thy grace for Thy chosen ones.

input: طوبی لذلیل تمسّک بحبل عزّی و لفقیر استظلّ فی سرادق غنائی.
output: Blessed the abased one who layeth fast hold on the cord of My glory. and the needy one who entereth beneath the shadow of the Tabernacle of My wealth.
prediction: Blest art thou, O Thou who clingest fast to the rope of Might, and O Thou who dost repose beneath the canopy of Splendor!

input: طوبی لجاهل اراد کوثر علمی و لغافل تمسّک بحبل ذکری.
output: Blessed the ignorant one who seeketh the fountain of My knowledge.
prediction: Blest be he who obeyeth the desire of Kudur and holdeth fast to the cord of remembrance.

input: طوبی لروح بعث من نفحتی و دخل ملکوتی.
output: and the heedless one who cleaveth to the cord of My remembrance. Blessed the soul that hath been raised to life through My quickening breath and hath gained admittance into My heavenly Kingdom.
prediction: Blest be the spirit breathed forth by Thy breath and entered into the kingdom.

input: طوبی لنفس هزّتها رایحة وصلی و اجتذبتها الی مشرق امری.
output: Blessed the man whom the sweet savors of reunion with Me have stirred and caused to draw nigh unto the Dayspring of My Revelation.
prediction: Blest be that soul, whose fragrance is the breath of communion, and who is drawn by its attraction towards the Orient of Command.

input: طوبی لأذن سمعت و للسان شهدت و لعین رأت و عرفت نفس الرّبّ ذی المجد و الملکوت و ذی العظمة و الجبروت.
output: Blessed the ear that hath heard and the tongue that hath borne witness and the eye that hath seen and recognized the Lord Himself, in His great glory and majesty, invested with grandeur and dominion.
prediction: Blessed be thine ear that heareth, and thy tongue that speaketh thereof, and thine eye that beholdeth, and knoweth the Spirit of the Lord, the Possessor of Glory and Kingdom, the Mighty and Almighty.

input: طوبی لمن استضآء من شمس کلمتی.
output: Blessed the man who hath sought enlightenment from the Daystar of My Word.
prediction: Blest am I, to be illumined by the radiance of Thy Word's Sun.

input: طوبی لمن زیّن رأسه باکلیل حبّی.
output: Blessed he who hath attired his head with the diadem of My love.
prediction: Blest be He who hath graced His head with the diadem of love.

input: طوبی لمن سمع کربی و قام لنصرتی بین شعبی.
output: Blessed is he who hath heard of My grief and hath arisen to aid Me among My people.
prediction: Blest be I who heareth thy cry for aid, and riseth to thy defense among thy people.

input: طوبی لمن فدی نفسه فی سبیلی و حمل الشّداید لاسمی.
output: Blessed is he who hath laid down his life in My path and hath borne manifold hardships for the sake of My name.
prediction: Blest am I whose life hath been sacrificed for Thy sake, and who beareth the burdens in Thy name.

input: طوبی لمن اطمأنّ بکلمتی و قام بین الأموات لذکری.
output: Blessed the man who, assured of My Word, hath arisen from among the dead to celebrate My praise.
prediction: Blest am I, O Thou Who hast reassured me by a word, and hast arisen among the dead for my sake.

input: طوبی لمن انجذب من نغماتی و خرق السّبحات بقدرتی.
output: Blessed is he that hath been enraptured by My wondrous melodies and hath rent the veils asunder through the potency of My might.
prediction: Blest am I, drawn by Thy melodies, and rent asunder by the power of Thy praises.

input: طوبی لمن وفی بعهدی و ما منعته الدّنیا عن الورود فی بساط قدسی.
output: Blessed is he who hath remained faithful to My Covenant, and whom the things of the world have not kept back from attaining My Court of holiness.
prediction: Blest be I, faithful in thy covenant; and though the world hath withheld me from entering upon thy holy threshold, yet art thou mindful of me.

input: طوبی لمن انقطع عن سوائی و طار فی هوآء حبّی و دخل ملکوتی و شاهد ممالک عزّی و شرب کوثر فضلی و سلسبیل عنایتی و اطّلع بأمری و ما سترته فی خزاین کلماتی و طلع من افق المعانی بذکری و ثنائی.
output: Blessed is the man who hath detached himself from all else but Me, hath soared in the atmosphere of My love, hath gained admittance into My Kingdom, gazed upon My realms of glory, quaffed the living waters of My bounty, hath drunk his fill from the heavenly river of My loving providence, acquainted himself with My Cause, apprehended that which I concealed within the treasury of My Words, and hath shone forth from the horizon of divine knowledge engaged in My praise and glorification.
prediction: Blessed am I, who hath been cut off from thy presence, and hath soared through the air of love, and entered the Kingdom, and hath beheld the realms of glory, and drunk of the cup of Thy grace and bounty, and hath been made to know of Thy commandment, and hidest Thou me in the treasures of words, and hast revealed me from the horizon of meanings through remembrance and praise.

input: انّه منّی.
output: Verily, he is of Me.
prediction: Verily, it is My gift.

input: علیه رحمتی و عنایتی و مکرمتی و بهائی.
output: Upon him rest My mercy, My loving-kindness, My bounty and My glory.
prediction: Unto Thee, O Thou of mercy, bounty, and grace.

input: مجموعه‌ای از الواح جمال اقدس ابهی که بعد از کتاب اقدس نازل شده
output: revealed after the Kitáb-i-Aqdas
prediction: A Collection of the Tablets of the Most Holy Beauty, which were revealed after the Holy Book.

input: هذا ندآء الأبهی الّذی ارتفع من الأفق الأعلی فی سجن عکّآء
output: This is the Call of the All-Glorious which is proclaimed from the Supreme Horizon in the Prison of 'Akká

input: هو المبیّن العلیم الخبیر
output: He is the Expounder, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

input: حقّ شاهد و مظاهر اسماء و صفاتش گواه که مقصود از ارتفاع ندا و کلمهٴ علیا آنکه از کوثر بیان آذان امکان از قصص کاذبه مطهّر شود و مستعدّ گردد از برای اصغاء کلمهٴ طیّبهٴ مبارکهٴ علیا که از خزانهٴ علم فاطر سماء و خالق اسماء ظاهر گشته.
output: God, the True One, testifieth and the Revealers of His names and attributes bear witness that Our sole purpose in raising the Call and in proclaiming His sublime Word is that the ear of the entire creation may, through the living waters of divine utterance, be purged from lying tales and become attuned to the holy, the glorious and exalted Word which hath issued forth from the repository of the knowledge of the Maker of the Heavens and the Creator of Names.

input: یا اهل ارض
output: O people of the earth!

input: بشارت اوّل
output: The first Glad-Tidings
